definitions.explanation: The process by which pollen is transferred to the female reproductive organs of a plant, enabling fertilization and seed production.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受粉|じゅふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: Bees help with the pollination of flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{受粉|じゅふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風媒|ふうばい}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: Pollination by wind is called wind pollination.

examples.japanese: {受粉|じゅふん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{果実|かじつ}→果実：00146_kajitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}らない→実る：00282_minoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If pollination doesn't go well, the fruit may not set.

notes:
{受粉|じゅふん} refers to the transfer of ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧ (pollen) to the ⟦{雌|め}しべ→雌しべ：29508_meshibe⟧ (pistil) of a plant, enabling ⟦{受精|じゅせい}→受精：29502_jusei⟧ (fertilization). Used in biology, agriculture, and gardening contexts.

ETYMOLOGY:
{受|じゅ} (receive) + {粉|ふん} (powder/pollen)

TYPES:
- ⟦{自家|じか}→自家：14071_jika⟧{受粉|じゅふん}: self-pollination
- {他家|たか}{受粉|じゅふん}: cross-pollination
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{受粉|じゅふん}: artificial pollination
- {風媒|ふうばい}{受粉|じゅふん}: wind pollination
- {虫媒|ちゅうばい}{受粉|じゅふん}: insect pollination

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {受粉|じゅふん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pollinate / to be pollinated
- {受粉|じゅふん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: to assist pollination
- {受粉|じゅふん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いく: pollination succeeds
